MVBC Tenners Saturday Social Ride

Corvallis, OR · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

MVBC Tenners Saturday Social Ride is a road group ride in Corvallis, OR. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Osborn Aquatic Center. About 30–60 miles, no-drop, 12–15 mph average.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @midvalley_bikeclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the MVBC Tenners Saturday Social Ride group ride

The club's Saturday social ride on paved roads around Corvallis. Around 12 to 15 mph with regroups so nobody is left behind. Newcomers are welcome. The club also runs a faster Saturday group and Wednesday road and gravel rides from the same spot.
